title: Kissed Peruvian Rapeseed Casserole
description: A festive and crumbly Peruvian dish, made with rapeseed oil, that is friendly to those who follow a sugar-free diet.

ingredients.name: ground beef or beef strips
ingredients.notes: optional, can replace with chicken or vegetables for a vegetarian option.

ingredients.name: kissing flower petals
ingredients.notes: available at Peruvian markets, or can be substituted with dried flowers.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine wheat, rapeseed oil, sugar-free honey, fermented ají amarillo paste, chopped scallions, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate pan, cook the ground beef or beef strips over medium heat, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook.
Add the diced asparagus, kissing flower petals, and a pinch of salt to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beef mixture to the mixing bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with sliced mozzarella cheese and crumbled feta cheese, if using.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with crushed Peruvian corn nuts, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
